generated.prompt: Last Monday, Tom ___ (see) a wonderful movie at the cinema.
generated.point_zh: 当句中有明确的过去时间状语（如 last Monday、yesterday 等）时，谓语动词应使用一般过去时。

generated.prompt: Listen! The baby ___ (cry) in the next room.
generated.point_zh: 当句中有 Look、Listen 等提示词表明动作正在发生时，谓语动词应使用现在进行时（am/is/are + doing）。

generated.prompt: Next Friday, the students ___ (have) a science exam in the lab.
generated.point_zh: 句中有明确的将来时间状语（如 next Friday）时，谓语动词应使用一般将来时（will + 动词原形 / be going to + 动词原形），而非一般现在时。

generated.prompt: My sister ___ (watch) TV every evening after dinner.
generated.point_zh: 一般现在时中，主语为第三人称单数时，谓语动词需使用三单形式（加-s或-es）

generated.prompt: That was the ___ (bad) meal I have ever eaten at this restaurant.
generated.point_zh: 在'the + 形容词 + 名词 + I have ever done'结构中，形容词须用最高级形式，注意不规则变化（如bad→worst）。

generated.prompt: He drives very ___ (careful) on rainy days.
generated.point_zh: 修饰动词需要用副词形式，形容词careful需加-ly变为副词carefully。

generated.prompt: She bought five ___ (book) from the bookstore yesterday.
generated.point_zh: 可数名词前有大于1的数词修饰时，名词须用复数形式

generated.prompt: The teacher asked three ___ (child) to clean the classroom after school.
generated.point_zh: 不规则名词复数形式：child 的复数为 children，需与前面的数词 three 保持数的一致。

generated.prompt: She picked five ___ (flower) from the garden this morning.
generated.point_zh: 可数名词前有大于1的数词修饰时，名词需用复数形式

generated.prompt:
Please correct the error in the following sentence:
She has made many progresses in her English studies this semester.
acceptable_answers: She has made much progress in her English studies this semester.
She has made a lot of progress in her English studies this semester.
generated.point_zh: 不可数名词progress没有复数形式，不能加-s，且修饰不可数名词应使用much而非many。

generated.prompt: The students have made great progresses this semester.
acceptable_answers: The students have made great progress this semester.
generated.point_zh: 不可数名词没有复数形式，progress（进步）为不可数名词，不能加-es变为progresses。

generated.prompt: Please correct the error in the following sentence: They bought some expensive furnitures for their new house.
acceptable_answers: They bought some expensive furniture for their new house.
generated.point_zh: 不可数名词（如furniture）没有复数形式，词尾不能加-s。

generated.prompt: Please correct the spelling error in the following sentence: We need to keep the two groups seperate during the experiment.
acceptable_answers: We need to keep the two groups separate during the experiment.
generated.point_zh: 常见拼写错误：separate 常被误拼为 seperate，需牢记正确拼写。

generated.prompt: I often recieve emails from my classmates.
acceptable_answers: I often receive emails from my classmates.
generated.point_zh: 常见易错词拼写：receive 中字母 c 后应接 ei 而非 ie，正确拼写为 receive。

generated.prompt: I didn't recieve your email yesterday.
acceptable_answers: I didn't receive your email yesterday.
generated.point_zh: 常见易错词拼写：receive 的正确拼写为 r-e-c-e-i-v-e，注意 ei 的顺序，不要误写为 ie。

generated.prompt: It took him ___ (a) hour to finish the homework.
generated.point_zh: hour 中 h 不发音，以元音音素开头，前面应使用冠词 an 而非 a。

generated.prompt: 请改正下列句子中的冠词错误：He is a honest boy who never tells lies.
generated.point_zh: 冠词a/an的选择取决于其后单词的首个发音音素，honest首字母h不发音，以元音音素开头，故用an。

generated.prompt: It takes about ___ (a) hour to get there by bus.
generated.point_zh: 不定冠词a/an的选择取决于其后单词的首个发音而非拼写，hour的h不发音，以元音音素开头，应用an。
